narrative.details:
The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us.  If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.

Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
narrative.objectives: Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, good. Thank you, adventurer. My heart swells with pride to see youths interested in the craft of leatherworking.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have my supplies, adventurer?
